name: Tianze Ding
biography: Tianze Ding is a senior security researcher at Tencent Security Xuanwu Lab. His research focuses on web security, active directory security and red teaming. He reported some vulnerabilities to Microsoft, Apple, Google, etc. He has spoken at BlackHat Asia.
